brand.title: The K-beauty platform connecting Korea and Latin America
brand.intro: Konecta is a beauty business connecting K-beauty with the Latin American market.
brand.body: As the name suggests — "Korea" plus the Spanish word "conecta" (to connect) — we introduce great Korean cosmetics to Latin American consumers, starting with Peru and Chile, and help Korean beauty brands connect with the Latin American market. We start by understanding local skin concerns and preferences; popularity back in Korea is never, on its own, a reason to recommend a product.
brand.diff1_d: We prioritize sun-care and hydration lines suited to real local skin concerns, from the Andes' intense UV to dry climates.
brand.diff2_d: We care more about a product's real value than its popularity in Korea, and only curate items with a clear, honest value — without the high price tag.
brand.diff3_t: We sell the experience, not just the product
brand.diff3_d: Mini test kits let you try it first, with zero risk.
brand.biz1_d: Margin on test kits and full-size product sales
brand.biz2_d: A recurring-purchase model built around a periodic subscription.
brand.biz3_d: A commission for onboarding Korean beauty brands onto the platform.
brand.biz4_d: Revenue from social content and influencer partnerships.
brand.road1_d: Validate early response with mini test kits.
brand.road2_d: Expand validated products into a recurring-subscription format.
brand.road3_d: Formalize partnerships with Korean beauty brands.
brand.road4_d: Grow beyond Peru and Chile to the wider region.
brand.quote: “I lived in Chile for three years and saw real local buying behavior firsthand. Interest in K-beauty runs high, but I watched up close how the lack of a chance to actually try a product first keeps that interest from ever turning into a purchase.”
